notes.title: BAR Release Update!
notes.content: [p]Bar has finally left early access and is now a full game with the addition of the final bar, Jera! Upon the completion of Jera, you drain out all of the data in the game to receive an Arc Boost! Arc Boosts are the final ultimate upgrade you can get in BAR! Each boost gives a whopping 20x fill rate and these can be obtained every time you restart the game and clear Jera! Although BAR is no longer in early access, this doesn't mean it stops here! If BAR still receives community support there will be more updates in the future![/p]

notes.title: Pattern Update
notes.content:
This new update adds the pattern feature! 

Patterns are a new way to increase your bar filling power. Patterns are earned by clearing bars and they change the shapes that appear in the background! Additionally, they provide massive bonuses to positive numbers. Patterns are available after reaching bar 500.

notes.title: BAR Beta Update + New Development
notes.content:
Hi all! I know it has been a very long time but I have been hard at work! I present, the Beta Update! This update comes with the following features.
[list]

[*] Massive game rebalance to early game and all swatches

[*] New set of widgets that are toggleable for extra rewards

[*] Two new sets of swatches

[*] New bar with new mechanics

[*] New elemental kit system

[*] New achievements and rewards

[*] New deadly opposing widgets for higher bars

[*] Four new machines
[/list]

Although it may not seem like much, these are very large changes!

[b]UPON LOGGING INTO BAR YOU WILL RECEIVE REWARDS TO UNLOCK A CHUNK OF NEW SWATCHES[/b]

These rewards will be available for some time after the beta update launches. The hope is to get players testing the new content faster.

The last thing to touch on will be future updates. BAR is not complete yet. There is still more to come, but I need to change the way that I have been developing the game. BAR will now be receiving smaller, more frequent updates. This will help me keep players engaged and also smooth out the game progression and balance. The old roadmap is now inaccurate.

Thank you for supporting BAR!

notes.title: Upcoming Content / Alpha v0.1.0
notes.content:
[h1]Update Content[/h1]

The following additions have been made to Bar in update version Alpha v0.1.0:

-Added a material indicator next to the start run button that shows the materials that can be obtained through that specific bar.

-Added the Color Ball mechanic. Once per day, a color ball will appear on one of the bar types. The Color Ball will appear randomly in the run on that bar, and will provide large amounts of materials and splotches when clicked. The amount of rewards you receive depends on how many total Color Balls you have found and your achievement level.

[h1]Upcoming Content[/h1]
I have big plans coming soon to Bar! The beta content update is being worked on and will add a large number of features to the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44868263/2c4201e7aeb609cbd0033799512811787c392e9c.png[/img]

The hope is to almost double the amount of content in the game. The beta version of Bar would have the initial release and additional updates as well. Once I am satisfied with the beta, I will move onto the next large content update. 

[h1]Roadmap[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44868263/f97fd4d35dd2ad5358570d7ac32a7276f44faa24.png[/img]

The current plan is to have four major content updates in total, with the last one being the full release. Between these updates would be fixes, minor content updates, and balance changes. Bar is still fairly early in development, so this plan could change. However, the hope is that nothing has to change and Bar will be smoothly developed. 

Please feel free to leave feedback, whether it is positive or negative. I want Bar to be a great game that many people can enjoy.
